notes.title: Zachariel Server Merge: Future Changes to Dormant Team Status
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Saviors![/p][p][/p][p]In this posting, we would like to announce the details about the [b]future status changes regarding the dormant teams [/b]in the[b] NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Target Criteria[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Dormant Target Server:[/b] [b]NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute[/b] [/p][p][b]Dormant Target Team:[/b] Teams that do not meet any of the following criteria below. [/p][p][/p][p][b]▶ Accounts that have[/b]: [/p][p]- Record of entering the game within 1 year before the Zachariel Server Merge (July 15, 2025).[/p][p]- Purchased Premium TP[/p][p]- Used Premium TP[/p][p]- Possessed Premium TP 
[/p][p][b]※ Accounts that only purchased Steam DLCs will be changed to Dormant Status. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]※ If you have a team for multiple servers in a single account, [u]the team must meet the criteria above to stay active[/u].[/p][p][b]EXAMPLE[/b]: (If you have teams on [b]all three servers,[/b] and only the teams on [b]EU Fedimian and SA Silute[/b] have [b]purchased TP and logged into the game[/b], while the team on [b]NA Klaipeda has not met any of the criteria, [/b]the team on [b]NA Klaipeda [/b]will be [b]set to dormant[/b]. Between the [b]EU Fedimian and SA Silute servers[/b], the dormant team will be determined according to the [b][url="https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=3386"]Global Merge Policy: When you have teams on more than one server[/url][/b].)[/p][p][/p][p]※ When the Team set to Dormant Status, the [b]Team will be deleted. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]※ If you want to restore your Dormant Account, you must[b] send a ticket [/b]during the[b] restoration period. (August 12, 2025)[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Details[/h2][p][/p][p]1. When a team is switched to dormant status, the [b]existing team will be removed[/b] and the UI for creating a new team will pop up upon entering the barrack.[/p][p][/p][p]2. If you wish to remove the dormant status from your team, you can[b] send us a ticket before August 12, 2025[/b].[/p][p]  - This request is[b] only [/b]accepted when [b]sent by the owner of the account[/b].[/p][p]  - The request is applied during the scheduled maintenance every week during the restoration period.[/p][p]  ※ If you already made a new team before requesting to remove the dormant status from the original team, this new team will be deleted. [/p][p][/p][p][b]3. All dormant teams cannot be recovered after the restoration period (August 12, 2025). [/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and interest in Tree of Savior.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Regards,[/p][p]IMC Staffs.[/p]

notes.title: Preview: Tree of Savior Zachariel Release and Integration of Region
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/b2b0588317b3671e1cca98ab778b98a37dd12f9e.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Saviors.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]To bring new encounters and expanded adventures to Tree of Savior, the current servers: [b]NA[/b] Klaipeda, [b]EU[/b] Fedimian, and [b]SA[/b] Silute will be [b]merged into a single server[/b] named ‘[b]Zachariel[/b]’ on [b]Tuesday, July 15, 2025 (KST).[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The new [b]Zachariel [/b]server will unite Saviors from various regions, forming a diverse community that transcends language and culture. We believe this significant change will inject vitality into the game, fostering more dynamic strategies and collaboration in an enriched gameplay environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Saviors from your favorite guilds and regions will be able to find new goals to work towards, while those who aren't tied to a guild or region will be able to create their own unique groupings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]No new installations or changes are required to access Zachariel Server[/b]. Simply launch the Tree of Savior client through Steam as usual, and you will automatically connect to the merged server.[/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️I[u]n the meanwhile, SA Silute TP Product Sales will be restricted due to this Server Merge[/u]⚠️ [/b][/p][p]
TP product sales in the SA server will be temporarily restricted starting from the date of this announcement. This is due to price standardization to align with NA/EU server pricing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/e9da67cc957c47d01f4acb21366bbe80fb40df74.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch of [b]Zachariel[/b], we have prepared a variety of exciting events for all Saviors.[/p][p]In particular,[b] special rewards[/b] will be awarded for the [b]first Guild Territory War[/b] after the integration.[/p][p][/p][p]The first[b] Guild Territory Wars (GTW)[/b] held in the [b]Zachariel[/b] server will offer special rewards. Guilds that occupy the Champion League regions —  'Genar Field', 'Aqueduct Bridge Area', and 'Baron Allerno'— will receive a commemorative guild flag engraved with a text and image of the guild’s choice. [/p][p]Additionally, amazing login rewards will be distributed to all players who log into the [b]Zachariel [/b]server within the first[b] 7 days [/b]after the merge.[/p][p]
             [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/1360aa9a9ac015adf9539495a7629c00671584a1.png"][/img]                 [/p][p]We’ve also prepared refreshing[b] summer events[/b] and [b]adorable new mounts[/b] to accompany your journey. We look forward to seeing your exciting adventures unfold in the new [b]Zachariel [/b]server.[/p][p][/p][p]※ The details of the event will be notified in the future announcement.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Zachariel [/b]integrations are guided by the following policies:[/p][p][/p][h2]Tree of Savior Global Merge Policy[/h2][p][/p][p] -  Date: Scheduled maintenance on [b]July 15, 2025 [/b][/p][p] -  Target: [b]NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute[/b][/p][p] -  Server Name: [b]North America Zachariel[/b][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Category[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Major Integration Policies[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]If you only have a team on 1 server[/p][/td][td][p] # The team is transferred without changes except for the reset categories[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]If you have teams on more than one server[/p][/td][td][p][b] # Only the information from one team, selected based on the criteria below, will be transferred, and no other team's information will be transferred. (The following criteria will be applied to determine which teams are transferred)[/b]
  1. Team with more premium TPs
  2. Team with higher team levels (experience)
  3. Team with more characters created
  4. Team with later team creation dates

[b] # Premium TPs are transferred to the final team after all teams' information is summed.[/b]
 - They are also transferred if they were converted to points using TP-packaged items.

[b] # For further activation of teams not selected by the above criteria, you will need to apply by creating a new STEAM account.[/b]
 - The details of the procedure will be announced in a separate announcement in the future.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Guild [/p][/td][td][p] [b]# General Guild[/b]
 - If the Guild Master's team is transferred, the guild will also be transferred and any guild members not transferred will be removed from the guild.
 - If the Guild Master's team is not transferred, the guild will be disbanded and the guild members will be changed to a guildless status.
 - If there are two guilds with the same guild name, the later created guild will be renamed to "Guildname_1" and will receive a “Guild Name Change Voucher”.

[b] # TOS Support Guild[/b]
 - If your team is a member of a TOS Support Guild, it will be transferred to the TOS Support Guild on the [b]\[NA] Klaipeda[/b] server.
 - The Guild Master/general guild member's rank and privileges are retained.

[b] # Not in a guild[/b]
 - If the team being transferred is not in a guild, it will be transferred as a guildless status.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] [b]※  Premium TPs are paid products, excluding free/event TPs.[/b][/p][p][b] ※  Data related to teams/characters/companions [u]deleted before the integration will be unrecoverable after the integration.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Reset Categories[/h2][h2][/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Category[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Details[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Ranking (Record)[/p][/td][td][p][b] # GTW Spot Capture Guilds[/b]
[/p][p][b] # Ranking/Records of the following contents[/b]
 - Blockade Battle, Joint Strike Raid, Weekly Boss Raid, Remnants of Bernice, Fishing, etc[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Guild[/p][/td][td][p][b] # Guilds that do not meet the integration conditions
 [/b][/p][p][b]# GTW tariff, Applications, Guild Tower, Declare War, etc[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Other[/p][/td][td][p][b] # If you have a duplicate team name[/b]
 - The team name of the first team to claim it is retained
 - However, even if the team name is claimed first, if the account hasn't been accessed within one year at the time of the integration, the team name of the other team with the access record will be retained.
 - If all teams have not accessed within a year, the first team to do so keeps the team name.
 - Other teams that don't keep their team name will be renamed to "Team name_1" and will be given a “Team Name Change Voucher”.[/p][p]
[b] # Items listed for sale in the market[/b]
 - These items will be unregistered and moved to your Market Retrieve Tab.
[/p][p][b] # Installed User Shops[/b]
 - All installed user shops such as Food Table, Repair Shop, Spell Shop, and Equipment Maintenance Shop will be removed
[/p][p][b] # Chat, Party[/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p] ※  Fishing Etching and Team Battle League are unavailable from[b] July 07[/b] ~ the scheduled maintenance on [b]July 15. [/b]
 ※  Guild Territory War will [b]not [/b]be held on[b] July 13. [/b]
 ※  The following contents will be unavailable during[b] July 14[/b] ~ the scheduled maintenance on[b] July 15.[/b]
     -  [b]Blockade Battle, Weekly Boss Raid, and Remnants of Bernice[/b]
 ※  Please receive the ranking rewards (ex; Blockade Battle) before the maintenance on[b] July 15, [/b]as all rankings and records will be reset.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]- As the servers are merged, all servers will use [b]NA Klaipeda (EST) Time Zone. [/b][/p][p]- The duration of various contents will be changed to be the same as NA Klaipeda. The changes are as follows.[/p][table equalcells="1" notes.title: [HOTFIX] Vaivora’s Team Challenge Issue

Greetings, Saviors!
 
After our scheduled maintenance of March 27, 2018, players reported the following issues: 
 
1. Players on [NA]/[SEA] servers being unable to open the Vaivora’s Team Challenge event shop to exchange their Vaivora Tokens. 

2. Players logging in and finding that the Night Market Event Debuff was still applied. 

We would like to announce that these problems have now been hotfixed. 
 
IMPORTANT: You will need to restart your game client in order for the hotfix to be applied. For players being affected by the Night Market Debuff, after restarting your client you must click the Event Notice Board for the buff to be removed. 

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience while the issue was being solved. If you are still being affected by these issues after restarting your client and receiving the hotfix, please let us know via Support Ticket.

notes.title: Changes to Market and Trade Use for New Teams
notes.notes:
Greetings, Saviors.

Apart from the administration of fraudulent billing and purchase activities by Valve's fraud department, we've implemented our own mechanism to provide additional security measures.

[b]Newly created teams will not be able to register items on the market and participate in 1:1 trades for 3 days (72 hours). After the 72-hour mark, players will be able to fully use the market and trade systems as intended.[/b]

*You can still [i]purchase[/i] items from the Market.

We'll be checking for cases of abuse during those 3 days, and block abusers and confiscate their items as necessary.

We hope to maintain a reliable in-game economy by preventing abusive commercial activities ahead of time, and request your cooperation.

We will be performing a temporary server maintenance to apply these changes as a patch. Please look out for our maintenance announcement on this particular feature.

Thank you for your kind understanding.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Changes regarding trading restrictions, bot policy
notes.notes:
Greetings, Saviors!

We’ve been listening to your recent feedback regarding trading restrictions and bot presence in Tree of Savior, and would like to announce some changes we’ll be making to improve your in-game experience.


[b]1) Less Trade Restrictions[/b]

As mentioned in previous announcements, the trade restrictions were implemented to address RMT issues. However, based on your feedback, we have determined that it may feel a bit too high-handed. 

As such we have decided to implement new measures to reduce the inconvenience of trading restrictions on non-Token users in order to reduce trading restrictions on regular users.

We are planning on allowing Non-Token users to partake in 1:1 trading. However, we are not yet certain how we will implement this new system. More details will be released as soon as they have been decided upon.

The changes are intended to remove restrictions to players who may not be Token users but wish to help out or give class restricted items to other players. We also hope this will dissuade bots from collecting items through farming.


[b]2) Bot Report Function[/b]

We wish to continuously strive towards reducing the bot problem and provide better gaming experiences for normal players.

As such, we are working on implementing the much requested bot report function. Not only that but we’re also developing and testing a system to detect bots faster. 

Through the reporting system, you will not only able to select and report suspected bots, but you will also be able to report items in the market suspected of being part of RMT (e.g. low-value items sold at unusually high prices). Through this system, GMs will be able to catch more bots by prioritizing and reviewing cases reported by users.

However, we know that this system can be misused or even abused and are in the process of polishing rules to regulate the system. We wish to provide merits to those who accurately report bots, and penalize those who misuse the system to report innocent users. This will most likely be a constantly updated set of rules since there will always be different cases.


As always, we thank you for your continued support, understanding, and enthusiasm for Tree of Savior.  

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

We wish to provide merits to those who accurately report bots, and penalize those who misuse the system to report innocent users. This will most likely be a constantly updated set of rules since there will always be different cases.


As always, we thank you for your continued support, understanding, and enthusiasm for Tree of Savior.  

Sincerely,
IMC Staff
